beats.label: The trial
beats.note: Kouraki, Valdes et al., Nutrients 2026 (INSPIRE trial)

beats.label: Fiber
beats.text: **20g** a day of **inulin,** a prebiotic fiber, cut pain about **1** **point** out of 10 vs placebo.

beats.label: Exercise
beats.text: Guided physio exercise cut pain about **1.5** **points** and helped **standing** and **walking** tests.

beats.label: The twist
beats.text: Only the fiber improved **grip** **strength** and lowered **pain** **sensitivity.**

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: Small and only **6** **weeks.** Fiber **doesn't** **replace** exercise or treatment. Ask your **doctor** first.
Follow for **joint** **health** research, minus the hype.
